show.description: This is a romantic drama set against the backdrop of power, identity, and social justice. The story follows Akira, a brave village girl who enters a forced marriage with Lakshya, a billionaire who hides his identity as a poor caterer. While Akira joins the Vardhan Group to stop the demolition of her village’s livelihood, Lakshya secretly helps her while maintaining his disguise. Their relationship evolves from awkward strangers to partners who fight injustice together. The show explores themes of class divide, hidden identity, ambition, love, and rural empowerment. With humour, romance, and emotional confrontations, the narrative builds towards Akira proving that compassion and roots are more powerful than wealth.
